title: merge --lane-lint names which open PR a head clashes with, and the fold build tests that clash before the lint
why: Coordinator 23:05 CST Nov 13 (relayed; unchecked by triage): merge --lane-lint refuses a head that conflicts with any open PR's head (merge-tree), with no override, and does not say which PR. A fold member has to be clash-tested against every open PR.
source: Coordinator message 23:05 CST Nov 13 (relayed). Related: steps release-pairwise-clash (todo) and merge-tree-check-tool (queued); no step is known to cover the naming or the fold-build order.
note: Triage 23:06 CST Nov 13: two parts. (1) The lint output names the open PR whose head clashes, so a lane can fix it earlier. (2) The batch runner's fold build clash-tests each member against all open PRs before it runs the lint. Check first whether release-pairwise-clash or merge-tree-check-tool already builds either part; if so, fold this into it and say so. A lane starts it; not started.
